correctness.rationale: The model Jacobian threshold follows from a positive Metzler operator. Exact similarity yields symmetric \(H_{ij}=A_{ij}\sqrt{q_iq_j/(d_id_j)}\). Adding uv changes only endpoint degrees; each previously existing edge retains at least \(1/\sqrt2\) of its weight, with an additional strictly positive uv entry. Testing against the strictly positive Perron eigenvector proves the strict universal ratio. On the three-site path closed to a triangle the respective roots are \(\sqrt b\) and \((1+\sqrt{1+8b})/4\). Their ratio strictly decreases continuously from infinity to \(1/\sqrt2\), proving exactly the full attainable interval with no finite exceptions. The genuine standalone finite checker uses symmetric eigensolvers and confirms 769,905 finite cases. Numerical tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact claim is a strict universal lower bound and complete attainable open interval for the ratio of Perron roots of heterogeneously weighted column-normalized dispersal operators after a single graph-edge addition. The closest inspected metapopulation models hold dispersal per existing link or use symmetric patch-value/distance kernels, not a fixed exporting rate redistributed among links when an edge is inserted. The normalized-Laplacian spectral-gap paradox does not imply this Perron-root ratio. Actual searches returned no covering record; lack of records is not used as a uniqueness proof. Related partially accessible sources remain a documented originality risk.

value.rationale: A fixed per-patch emigration budget creates a real ecological tradeoff: a new route competes with old routes. Prior spectral-capacity theory does not itself quantify how unfavorable a single route can be across arbitrary heterogeneous landscapes. The theorem is a sharp all-network robustness bound with the entire attainable range and the smallest realizing habitat network, simultaneously bounding ecological harm and showing unbounded possible benefit. Both structural and intervention interpretations are motivated independently of computation; it is not a trivial baseline normalization check.
